referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Electricity including overhead operations and office use, materials, transport of materials, infrastructure. Module processing includes film deposition, etching, cleaning and module assembly. Process emissions not known (except Cd).
referenceFunction.name: Photovoltaic laminate, CdTe, at plant

technology.text: Production technology of thin film cells. Sublimation of the powders and condensation of the vapours on a glass substrate by vapour transport deposition (VTD).

representativeness.extrapolations: Waste disposal from factory approximated with data for crystalline modules. The quantity of several small material uses (about 700 items) has been summarized for some main materials.
